summary: CHOSEN BRICK is a Windows malware family used by Iranian state cyber actors since at least 2025 to target dissidents, activists and journalists in the UK, US, Netherlands and elsewhere. It is delivered through social-engineering on messaging platforms using lures disguised as legitimate applications, persists via the HKCU Run key, and uses per-victim Telegram bots plus cloud object stores for command and control and exfiltration. The malware supports process and system discovery, screen and microphone capture, Telegram/WhatsApp and email theft, additional payload downloads and data wiping.
